title.narrative: Prevent, inform and improve: a health and nutrition integrated project for vulnerable populations in Mayo and Port Sudan

description.narrative: The Overall Objective (OO) of the proposed action is to contribute to the improvement of the quality of life of marginalised and underserved populations in Mayo area (Khartoum State), and Port Sudan (Red Sea State). The Specific Objective (SO) of the proposed action aims to ensure access to free and quality primary healthcare services, as well as awareness raising on health, hygiene and nutrition, and capacity building of EMERGENCY local staff and partner organisation¿s staff members.
